 Home NBA lebron james Kendrick Perkins says Dallas Mavericks have a ‘forgotten child’ who’s giving ‘LeBron James vibes’
 Shamanth Jayaram Thu 29 October 2026 10:20, UK Photo by Emilee Chinn/Getty Images Follow us on Google Discover It’s another day and another young player is being compared to LeBron James – this time by Kendrick Perkins. 
 Perkins, a former NBA champion, has been around the game for a long, long time, so his opinions hold a lot of weight, especially when he is talking about an up-and-coming star. 
 The player in question is young Cooper Flagg.
 Who is on your Dallas Mavericks Mount Rushmore? 🏔️
 Debate your four greatest Mavericks in the comments below!
 Comment Like or Comment Have your say Sign-in now for free Kendrick Perkins says ‘forgotten child’ Cooper Flagg gives him LeBron James vibes
 Flagg has been one of the most impressive young players in the NBA this season. 
 The 19-year-old has played in four of the Dallas Mavericks’ first five games, and he has impressed in every single one of those appearances. 
 Perkins sure seems to be a big fan of Flagg, so much so that he has compared him to one of the greatest players of all time: LeBron James. 
 He also hailed the Mavs teen as a generational talent and called him one of the most complete players in basketball today.
 COOPER FLAGG LEADS THE WAY, DALLAS DEFEATS OKC AT HOME!
🤠 26 points
🤠 5 boards
🤠 8 assists pic.twitter.com/2sj56zMpOe 
— NBA (@NBA) October 29, 2026 View X Perkins said on ESPN before the Mavs’ game against the Thunder: “I feel like Cooper Flagg has become the forgotten child. You’ve got to remember, he is a generational talent. When you talk about the most complete players in the game, there’s only a handful of guys I’d put in front of him.
 MORE LEBRON JAMES STORIES “Just watch him, there’s nothing he can’t do. If you need him to get downhill off the pick and roll, he can do that. He’s versatile defensively. He’s bringing it up, he’s setting up the offence. His patience, it gives me LeBron James-type vibes. When he gets in the lane, he’s finishing in traffic.
 Perkins also added: “He’s averaging six assists, 25 points and around six rebounds. That is filling up the stat line after a block of games. That’s LeBron James vibes!”
 The LeBron comparisons are perhaps a bit too far for Flagg, considering he’s just 19, but the youngster definitely deserves praise for how well he has played.
 If he keeps his head down, works hard and continues playing the way he has been, he could become a superstar in the coming years.
